title: Simulating Evolutionary Processes with Mizer
text: Instead generating phenotypic diversity within existing species, model can instead introduce mutants existing ecosystem. One just needs give data frame mutation argument instead numeric.  Randomly introducing alien species. giving integer alien argument, become rate per thousand invation rate. alien_n_init controls initial level abundance introducing invasive species. multiplier inital abundance calculated create size spectrum. Default set NULL, making kappa/1000.  One can supply data frame trait values used create invasive species using trait_range. default data frame values taken North Sea parameters. current assumptions : w_inf follows logarithmic distribution beta follows u-shaped distribution caracterised fitting two normal distributions small betas (piscivore) large betas (planktivore) species sigma, k_vb, ks eta follow normal distribution w_mat generated w_inf x eta Next update: switch beta, sigma, k_vb ks uniform distribution

title: Simulating Evolutionary Processes with Mizer
text: argument updateParams evoParams updates existing mizerParams object mizerEvolution compatible object.  differences mutation set 0   Invasions work
code: newP <- evoParams(updateParams = NS_params)  sim <- evoProject(params = newP, mutation = 1, trait = "beta") #> [1] "Data handling"  plotDynamics(sim) old_sim <- project(NS_params)  sim <- evoProject(params = newP, mutation = 0)  plotDynamics(sim) plotBiomass(old_sim) sim_inv <- evoProject(params = newP, mutation = 0, alien =2)  plotDynamics(sim_inv)

title: Project evolutionary simulation forward in time — evoProject
text: params MizerParams object created evoParams(). initCondition optional previous MizerSim object continue . t_max Total simulation time years. Default 100. dt Time step projection. Default 0.1. mutation Mutation rate per time step per thousand (numeric), data frame specifying mutation events. trait trait subject mutation. Default "w_mat". initPool Initial number mutant phenotypes created start. Default 0. initSpread Spread factor initial phenotype trait distribution. Default 5. alien Rate alien invasions per time step per thousand (numeric), data frame invading species. alien_init_n Multiplier initial alien abundance density. trait_range Optional trait range data frame alien_synthesis(). saveFolder Directory storing temporary simulation step files. effort Fishing effort. Default 0.

title: mizerEvolution 0.1.0
text: Upgraded package compatible mizer 3.4. Switched S3 MizerParams MizerSim classes modernized slot access. Registered extension via recordExtension(). Renamed min_w_inf max_w_inf evoParams() min_w_max max_w_max, R_factor reproduction_level (lifecycle deprecation warnings backwards compatibility). Updated rate function calls (getMort(), getERepro()). Fixed dimensions data structures evoProject(), finalTouch(), plotting functions. Added comprehensive unit test suite covering constructors, simulation stepping, plotting functions.
